text:
leslie: quick proposal — introduce a short 'closure gate' for postmortem actions plus a light comms template. goal: fewer stale items and clearer handoffs. sketch below.

leslie: Closure gate summary (pilot):
- T+0: IC named, impact tags added (latency/errors/data-loss), short triage note in-thread
- T+48: create remediation card(s) if anything unresolved; fields required: owner, ETA, verification step, priority
- T+14d: verification checkpoint — owner posts verification result or short blocker note
- T+21d: closure gate: if verification absent -> escrow takeover or mark as long-term with sponsor
- T+30d: auto-alert on any open card without explicit next-step

leslie: Comms template while incident active: daily 09:15 one-line status in-thread, ops-bot posts a 48h stakeholder summary when incident >48h, and customer-facing note draft within 72h for P1s.

rachael: +1. require a measurable verification step (one metric or smoke test) not just "deploy fix". ops-bot should reject cards missing verification.

priya: ops-bot can enforce that. I can wire the tracker so it refuses to create a card unless verification field non-empty and ETA provided. also schedule T+14 and T+21 reminders.

ops-bot: automation_registered -> "closure_gate_enforcement" for thread 2500004444.

sahil: suggestion on escrow: default escrow owner = oncall IC for infra/runtime actions. escrow auto-takes after 48h post-ETA if no verification and ETA <=21d. long-term items (>21d) get a sponsor instead and no auto-takeover.

rachael: IC rotation tweak: 2-week IC blocks, 3-day shadow overlap at end of block for handoff. shadow reads last 3 incidents and confirms readiness. reduces knowledge loss.

leslie: for recurrence detection: if a service has 3 incidents with the same symptom tag in 90d, auto-tag threads with "pattern-review" and schedule a 30m triage. keep invite small: owners + product rep + one SRE.

priya: I'll wire the recurrence rule into the tracker and have ops-bot post the pattern-review invite automatically when threshold met.

leslie: pilot responsibilities: priya -> tracker + ops-bot, rachael -> playbook text, sahil -> run escrow pilot on next P1, leslie -> measure pilot metrics (time-to-close, percent auto-takeovers, overdue cards). please ack ownership below.

rachael: ack — will draft playbook text and add verification examples.

priya: ack — wiring enforcement and reminders today.

sahil: ack — will run pilot and report back in 2 weeks.

ops-bot: reminder_scheduled -> "T+14 verification checkpoint" for thread 2500004444.

leslie: thanks. if pilot looks good we can merge closure gate into the incident playbook and add a one-slide runbook change to the oncall handbook.
